screenshots.name: chat-desktop
screenshots.caption: Text channels with images, GIFs, reactions and mentions
screenshots.alt: The #general channel of the Couch Co-op community on desktop: a mention, a game screenshot with emoji reactions, an animated GIF, and the member list grouped by role with online status.

screenshots.name: thread-desktop
screenshots.caption: Threads keep side conversations out of the main channel
screenshots.alt: A thread about Friday's game night open beside the #general channel, with five replies.

screenshots.name: voice-desktop
screenshots.caption: Drop-in voice channels, with speaking indicators and a persistent voice bar
screenshots.alt: The Squad Up voice channel on desktop: a stage of three participant tiles, two of them outlined because they are speaking, and the voice controls at the bottom.

screenshots.name: dms-desktop
screenshots.caption: Direct messages and group DMs, with unread badges
screenshots.alt: A direct message conversation on desktop, with the conversation list showing unread counts.

screenshots.name: community-settings-desktop
screenshots.caption: Community settings, members and roles
screenshots.alt: The community settings page of Lumen Studio, a product team's community, with its banner, name and description.

screenshots.name: community-roles-desktop
screenshots.caption: Roles with granular permissions
screenshots.alt: The Roles tab of the Lumen Studio community settings, listing the default Community Admin, Moderator and Member roles and the custom Release Manager and Designer roles, with their permissions.

screenshots.name: chat-light-desktop
screenshots.caption: Light and dark themes with twelve accent colours
screenshots.alt: The #dev channel of Lumen Studio, a product team's community, in the light theme with a violet accent: a pull-request link preview, a code block and a five-reply thread.

screenshots.name: notifications-desktop
screenshots.caption: Mentions, replies and DMs in one notifications inbox
screenshots.alt: The notifications page listing direct messages, a mention and a thread reply.

screenshots.name: dms-light-desktop
screenshots.caption: Direct messages in the light theme
screenshots.alt: A direct message conversation in the light theme.

screenshots.name: dms-accent-desktop
screenshots.caption: Every accent colour works in both modes
screenshots.alt: The "Launch crew" group direct message in the dark theme with a teal accent and vibrant intensity.

screenshots.caption: The same chat, built for phones
screenshots.alt: The #general channel on a phone: a message with a thread, a game screenshot with reactions, an animated GIF and the message composer.

screenshots.name: community-phone
screenshots.caption: Channel list with unread channels and who is in voice
screenshots.alt: The Couch Co-op channel list on a phone, with unread channels marked and the people currently in the Squad Up and AFK voice channels.

screenshots.name: thread-phone
screenshots.caption: Threads open full screen on phones
screenshots.alt: The Friday thread open full screen on a phone, with five replies.

screenshots.name: voice-phone
screenshots.caption: Voice on the go
screenshots.alt: The Squad Up voice channel on a phone, with participant tiles and compact voice controls.

screenshots.caption: Your conversations at a glance
screenshots.alt: The direct message list on a phone, with unread badges and message previews.

screenshots.alt: The Couch Co-op member list on a phone, grouped by role (Community Admin, mods) and online status.

videos.name: hero
videos.caption: Semaphore Chat in 15 seconds
videos.alt: A short looping clip: a message is typed and sent in a community's #general channel, a reaction is added, a thread opens, and then the Squad Up voice channel shows two people talking.

videos.name: tour
videos.caption: A 40-second tour of Semaphore Chat
videos.alt: A guided tour: sending a message and adding a reaction in a channel, opening a thread, replying to a direct message, sending a GIF from the GIF picker on a phone, a voice channel with people speaking, and the light theme with the voice bar.
